pre_d2_bootstrap.when: Lead/Human only, before D2 reviews this candidate. 04 does not execute.
pre_d2_bootstrap.purpose: Create an independent 05 Delivery Reviewer that can review this exact D1 correction candidate. Not a six-role live cutover.
in_scope: create new 05 agent with a new UUID
import or skill create delivery-review from skills/delivery-review/SKILL.md
agent skills add parent-handoff-wake (existing id aab482f9-b9ff-4b78-8394-1f13e2b319c0) if missing
agent skills add delivery-review after import (id then known)
optional: bind shared handoff to the new 05 only if D2 SELF_CHECK requires it
out_of_scope: add new 05 to business Squad routing

d3_full_apply.when: only after D2 APPROVE and Human publish confirmation
d3_full_apply.purpose: Apply the six-role after-state, shared skill, QA skill add, squad mapping, and retire old 05 from normal routing

shared_skill.name: multica-context-handoff
shared_skill.resolve_and_readback_required: after import: multica skill list --output json -> match name multica-context-handoff -> record id -> multica skill get <id>; bind only a resolved, read-back id (never a placeholder)
shared_skill.d3: import, resolve + read back id, then agent skills add to 01-04, 06, and new 05

product-quality-gate.resolve_and_readback_required: after import: multica skill list --output json -> match name product-quality-gate -> record id -> multica skill get <id>; bind only a resolved, read-back id (never a placeholder)

ops_pre_d2_state: pre-D2 bootstrap completed and live read back before D2 (new 05 edff0eba exists with delivery-review + parent-handoff-wake). Recorded here as resolved IDs; the ops list stays as the exact reference of what was executed.

ops_d3.purpose: F2 hard prerequisite: before any write, capture the complete non-sensitive before state and keep executable rollback material -- not only hashes
ops_d3.capture_scope: all affected agents (01, 02, 03, 04, 06, new 05, old 05), their full instruction text + ID + bindings, the squad full state, and the full content of delivery-review, product-quality-gate, milestone-quality-gate, multica-context-handoff
ops_d3.save_to: isolated run workdir before-capture/ (raw capture files); missing capture => STOP before any write
ops_d3.use: compute the after-state from the captured before set; recompute immediately before each write; drift => STOP and return to Lead

ops_d3.note: exception-path only; not a normal READY hop

ops_d3.action: exit normal routing; keep history; do not rename into delivery-reviewer

qa_06_binding_exception_plan.readback: multica agent skills list 30ce43d4-97a7-42a8-ab3e-78df0d894702 --output json; compare with the computed after set
qa_06_binding_exception_plan.rollback: multica agent skills set with the captured before set (parent-handoff-wake + milestone-quality-gate)
constraints: set replaces all assignments; keep every unrelated valid binding
do not delete the shared milestone-quality-gate skill object
agent skills set stays disabled until the exception is granted
